# Manager-v2 canonical golden bodies

New manager-v2 only, not a change to observer-v2/v1 or immutable 860d artifacts. These are contract examples, not native measurements or captures. Same five v2 POST paths and same43 verbs.

PairSelection is fixed devicePolicy control-full-account-v1 +devicePermission write. Offers contain no permission/roots. A source can still be busy, notReady, sourcePolicyDenied or intrinsicReadOnly without being a device ViewOnly.

Delivery and control epoch7 in the controlled attachment illustrate association with the SAME actual Runtime controller lease. Busy/intrinsic attachments carry input:null and an actual observer delivery, never a fake controller. Only backend-native records can prove those associations.

GBtj illustrates CAN+RIS, not a FullState guarantee. Manager recovery dimensions are native-grid bounded, separate from observer2..500. Binary gAD/DQ== is exact bytes80,00,ff,0d. Mouse is structured and includes its accepted recovery/grid stamp. Omitted settledAt is Unavailable, not Legacy or captured null. Receipts copy no input and report actual matched accepted bytes.

Protocol exports and strict types are shellfox_protocol::manager_v2. These definitions do not enable production routes or a new native creator.
